# Planistan

> Public London planning-application datasets, published as static Parquet files.

Planistan aggregates public council planning-register data. The files are snapshots,
not authoritative live registers; follow each dataset's source link for official records.
Fields may be null where a council omits data or detail-page enrichment is unavailable.

## Discovery files

- [Dataset manifest](https://planistan.github.io/datasets.json): JSON object keyed by borough; includes title, source, Parquet path, maturity, quality caveats, and completion metadata.
- [Operations snapshot](https://planistan.github.io/ops.json): JSON snapshot of pipeline freshness and completion; operational fields may change.

## Planning datasets

- [barking_dagenham](https://planistan.github.io/boroughs/barking_dagenham/parsed/unified.parquet): Barking & Dagenham Planning Applications; source: London Borough of Barking & Dagenham (Council Direct). Caveat: Search capture works, but Council Direct detail pages are still blocked by AWS WAF so applicant and agent fields remain limited.
- [barnet](https://planistan.github.io/boroughs/barnet/parsed/unified.parquet): Barnet Planning Applications; source: London Borough of Barnet (planning portal). Caveat: Idox capture is stable, but some applicant fields are placeholder source values and are intentionally normalized away.
- [bexley](https://planistan.github.io/boroughs/bexley/parsed/unified.parquet): Bexley Planning Applications; source: London Borough of Bexley (planning portal).
- [brent](https://planistan.github.io/boroughs/brent/parsed/unified.parquet): Brent Planning Applications; source: London Borough of Brent (planning portal).
- [bromley](https://planistan.github.io/boroughs/bromley/parsed/unified.parquet): Bromley Planning Applications; source: London Borough of Bromley (Arcus). Caveat: Arcus capture is live, but this borough is still marked experimental while coverage and enrich behavior are validated over broader runs.
- [city_of_london](https://planistan.github.io/boroughs/city_of_london/parsed/unified.parquet): City of London Planning Applications; source: City of London Corporation (planning portal).
- [croydon](https://planistan.github.io/boroughs/croydon/parsed/unified.parquet): Croydon Planning Applications; source: London Borough of Croydon (planning portal). Caveat: Idox capture is stable, but some applicant fields are placeholder source values and are intentionally normalized away.

## Shared Parquet schema

All borough files use the same nullable column model. Inspect the embedded Parquet
schema before querying because additive columns and physical types can evolve.

- Identity/source: `source_borough`, `reference`, `source_pdf`, `source_html`, `idox_keyval`, `portal_url`, `documents_url`, `weekly_url`.
- Application: `location`, `proposal`, `drawings`, `ward`, `our_contact`, `planning_class`, `hmo`, `garden`.
- Parties: `applicant_name`, `applicant_name_raw`, `applicant_agent`, `applicant_agent_raw`, `agent_name`, `agent_company`.
- Dates: `registered`, `registered_raw`, `validated`, `validated_raw`, `decided`, `decided_raw`, `week`, `date_anomaly`.
- Status: `status` is normalized; `status_raw` preserves the source value; `detail_enrich_state` describes detail lookup coverage.
- Address/geography: `postcode`, `outcode`, `address_kind`, `building_number`, `street_name`, `parse_confidence`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `geocode_accuracy`, `geocoded_at`.

Dates are stored as Parquet date/timestamp values where available. Text, coordinates,
and flags are nullable. Treat `reference` as council-scoped; use (`source_borough`,
`reference`) as the cross-dataset identifier. Consult `qualityStatus` in the manifest
before comparing completeness across boroughs.

## Fetch and parse

Fetch the manifest first, resolve each root-relative `parquet` value against
`https://planistan.github.io`, and use normal HTTPS GET requests. Example:

```sh
curl -L --fail -o barnet.parquet https://planistan.github.io/boroughs/barnet/parsed/unified.parquet
duckdb -c "DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM read_parquet('barnet.parquet');"
```

DuckDB can query a file without a separate download:

```sql
SELECT source_borough, reference, registered, status, proposal
FROM read_parquet('https://planistan.github.io/boroughs/barnet/parsed/unified.parquet')
LIMIT 20;
```

Clients should use HTTP cache validators when polling, set bounded timeouts, and avoid
repeatedly downloading every borough. Parquet readers include DuckDB, PyArrow, Polars,
and pandas with a Parquet engine.

## Usage and attribution

Planistan is released under CC0-1.0. Attribution to Planistan is appreciated but not
required. Retain the manifest's council source URL when redistributing extracts, check
the originating council for authoritative records and any source-specific terms, and do
not present inferred or incomplete fields as official council determinations.

## Optional

- [Planistan source repository](https://github.com/cottrell/planistan): scraper and UI source, schema implementation, and issue history.
- [Human-facing site](https://planistan.github.io/): interactive browser UI for the same datasets.
